observed_cross_run_pattern.key_control_fact: Phase403 and Phase404 used the exact same literary payload SHA in isolated fresh writer chats; Phase404 changed only the outer response-boundary transaction.

evidence: Phase404 readiness verified the embedded Phase403 payload exact-match.
Historical failure examples, AI/dialogue evaluator terms and broad neutral inventory were absent from writer-visible input.
The Phase404 writer ran in a separate fresh chat.
causal_classification.limitation: The outer response wrapper changed between Phase403 and Phase404, so wrapper-induced decoding effects cannot be ruled out completely; there is no evidence that hidden coordinator state itself leaked.

evidence: Identical literary payload produced materially different semantic gate outcomes across two fresh runs.
Only one run exists for each condition, so no statistical variance estimate is available.
causal_classification.interpretation: Sampling variation exposed a latent degree-of-freedom problem; it should not be treated as an excuse to retry until a passing sample appears.

evidence: The Phase402/403 mechanism freezes actor commitments but still lets the renderer decide when optional information emissions occur and how they answer adjacent dialogue.
The writer-visible live-vector packet exposes abstract desired state, personal cost and unresolved outcome semantics directly to the renderer.
Phase404 shows the renderer can re-liquidate those abstractions into executive-summary narration and shared-agenda dialogue even when deterministic adjacency counts remain clean.
causal_chain: abstract semantic objective remains directly visible to renderer
renderer locally optimizes prose toward semantically useful completion
optional non-focal emissions are placed where they best answer current focal agenda
fresh-run sampling determines whether this latent freedom stays quiet or becomes visible
semantic dialogue, response ownership and global optimization can therefore regress together

rejected_explanations: short paragraph ratio as root cause
generic instruction to sound less AI

minimal_stability_fix.component_1: Move abstract live-vector semantics back to coordinator-only control and compile them into concrete current-state affordances before writer exposure.
minimal_stability_fix.component_2: Replace optional non-focal information-emission freedom with pre-owned causal event cards whose trigger is the non-focal actor's own ongoing task/environment state, not the focal character's immediately preceding line.
minimal_stability_fix.component_3: Writer may realize wording and local sensory texture but may not select new information-bearing non-focal next-state or attach coordinator-only semantic interpretation.

validation_limit: With the user's one-A1 budget, Phase405 can only show prospective survival of the next independent fresh run. It cannot statistically prove universal cross-run stability. Any claim stronger than bounded next-run stability is forbidden.
